name: Chaozhou Style Dehua White Porcelain Set
marketing_tip: Perfect for the traditional Chaozhou 'Kung Fu' tea ceremony with its high-clarity white porcelain.
body: This Chaozhou-inspired set from Dehua features a beautifully weighted gaiwan and three cups, following the classic 'three-cup' configuration. The refined porcelain ensures a pure taste and a professional-grade brewing experience for hotel or home use.
original_title: 德化白瓷潮汕功夫茶具套装陶瓷泡茶杯悬停盖碗三杯酒店家用可定制
